verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents a programmatic API for controlling docs, an official CLI (rdme), and a Git-driven workflow, so headless automation is plausible as a first-party capability. However, the pack never explicitly documents CI usage such as GitHub Actions, pipeline setup, or non-interactive auth. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, details of CLI commands and their headless behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Control your docs programmatically with the ReadMe API
Run documentation entirely through Git, with Markdown and OpenAPI in your repository and pull requests as the review step.
